title: TranslateDisclosureText
description: Machine translations of one free-text field of a disclosure (e.g. a lobbying registrant's goals), emitted by the translation service. Keyed by (system, disclosure_id) as UpsertDisclosure is, the field named by `field`; a sink applies it to the existing disclosure and never creates one. Carries the source text, so a sink can drop a translation of text the disclosure no longer has.

field.description: The UpsertDisclosure details key the text is, e.g. 'goals' (stored as detail_goals). A sink builds property names from it.

text.description: The source text that was translated.

source_lang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the source text's language, or 'und' when nobody could tell.

source_lang_origin.description: Where source_lang came from: 'stated' by the source, 'detected' from the text by a model (see detected_by), or 'unknown'.

detected_by.description: The model that detected source_lang, when source_lang_origin is 'detected'.

translations.description: ISO 639-1 code -> translated text. EU official languages only; never the source language.
